title: Question curtains quality
text: Question curtains quality. These are a good value but quality is what I question. I’ve had these curtains for a few weeks and the back side of the curtains facing outside is starting to pill and get fuzzy. I’ve never had curtains do that before which makes me question the longevity of these curtains. I purchased 12 panels (6 pairs) and they all are have the same change happening with minimal usage. I didn’t wash them or iron them so I don’t know why this is occurring. If you’re on a budget and need to darken your room these certainly do it but I can’t recommend these. I wish I can return these but I threw out the packaging.

product_metadata.title: HLC.ME Lopez Velvet Premium Soft Light Filtering Back Tab Rod Pocket Window Treatment Curtain Drapery Panels for Bedroom & Living Room - Set of 2 Panels (54 x 84 inches Long, Gold)

details.Product Care Instructions: Curtains got a little dusty? Don't fret! Simply toss the curtains in the wash on a cold cycle. Then tumble dry them in the dryer so that they are smooth to the touch. But be sure that you do not bleach them so that they maintain their beauty.
